correctness.rationale: Use Wannenburg–Raftery uniqueness of the reflection interval R(D) within an even negatively generated chain, odd Sugihara rigorous-extension shell of 2s idempotent elements, and GSM fibers. For |D|=d, skeletal radius k requires k singleton positive fibers and k+1 nonempty negative/zero fibers, yielding binomial(d-k-1,k) types, 0<=k<=floor((d-1)/2). Sum over k has ordinary generating series x/(1-x-vx^2), and v=1 gives F_d. Even order 2t obeys d+s+1=t and has unique all-idempotent type, so H_{2t}(u)=1+sum_{d=1}^{t-1} F_d u^d, c_{2t}=F_{t+1}; odd orders have only their Sugihara type. Triple generating function z/(1-z)*(1+uz/(1-uz-u^2*v*z^2)), and shell law F_{t-j-1}/(F_{t+1}-1) -> phi^{-j-2}. Independently computed sum_k binomial(d-k-1,k)=F_d for d=1..14 and matched low-order examples; proof relies on original uniqueness/classification theorems rather than finite checks.
